{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Wedge!'' We have confirmation! It's an Imperial ''Strike cruiser!'' It's essential that it does not escape to give away our position!|Alliance Fleet [[Unidentified Rebel commander (Haven)|commander]], to [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire 1">[[Shadows of the Empire 1|''Shadows of the Empire'' 1]]</ref>}}
Shortly following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''''Strike''-class medium cruiser''' happened upon the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] secret [[Haven|rendezvous point]] beyond the [[Galactic Rim/Legends|Galactic Rim]]. The [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] destroyed the [[Strike-class medium cruiser|Strike cruiser]] and its complement of TIEs; however, the ship was able to beam the fleet's location to the ''[[Executor]]'', forcing the Rebels off their original course.
